title: Second marriage during pendency of divorce - the legal consequences
p1:
A divorce case is pending. Can a person simply move on and marry someone else? The answer may surprise you.

Many people believe that filing for divorce means the marriage has already ended. But legally, that is not always true.
p2: Until a divorce decree is passed by the court, the first marriage continues to exist in the eyes of law. A second marriage during this period can create serious legal consequences, including the possibility of criminal action for marrying again while the earlier marriage is still valid.
p3:
The key takeaway is simple: separation and divorce are not the same thing. Living apart, filing a petition, or waiting for hearings does not give automatic permission to remarry. The legal relationship ends only when the court officially grants divorce.

Before taking such a major step, checking the legal status of the marriage can prevent years of complications.
conclusion: Do you think people should be more aware that filing for divorce does not legally end a marriage? Share your views in the comments.
